An '''Authority Waiver''' was a document issued by the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] exempting [[Starship/Legends|starships]] from various Authority requirements on vessel standards. The full roster of starships was referred to as the [[Waivers List]].
